import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.head(20).to_string())

import sys, importlib.util, os
print(sys.version)
for mod in ["pandas", "openpyxl", "xlrd", "xlwt", "pyxlsb", "odf", "numpy"]:
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(mod)
    print(mod, "FOUND" if spec else "missing")
print("cwd:", os.getcwd())
print("files:", os.listdir("."))
skill = ".codex/skills/xlsx"
if os.path.isdir(skill):
    print("skill dir:", os.listdir(skill))

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}
